translation: (In dread of salty water and incompatible with veratrum 藜蘆.) Original text of the Benjing: Salvia (丹參), flavor bitter, slightly cold. It chiefly treats heart and abdominal pathogenic qi, faint intestinal sounds as if water running (腸鳴幽幽如走水), cold-heat accumulations, breaks masses and removes swellings (症瘕), stops vexation and fullness, and boosts qi.
